dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest point of the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a sharp terminal point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical expansion on the right lateral margin (viewer perspective) compared to the left; edges are otherwise smooth where they meet the water-line.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity light grey to off-white median tone across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct, dark circular void located at the anterior apex of the visible dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible dark longitudinal crease or furrow along the sagittal plane of the dorsal ridge, beginning at the mid-section and extending toward the peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple fine, curvilinear high-contrast white lines across the mid-dorsal and posterior surface, likely representing surface water run-off or shallow skin folds.
